title: dryopteris viscidula
intro: Dryopteris viscidula, commonly known as the viscid fern or sticky fern, is a species of fern in the genus Dryopteris. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris viscidula include soothing skin irritations, treating wounds, and reducing fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
